title: Zoning map change for 47-03 108th Street, Corona
summary: This rezones a site at 47-03 108th Street in Corona, Queens from R6B to R7D with a C2-4 overlay, as modified by the Council from the original R7X proposal. It would allow a 13-story mixed-use building with about 119,500 square feet of floor area, roughly 119 apartments (30 income-restricted), plus commercial and community facility space. The City Planning Commission's decision was approved with modifications on August 13, 2026.
